developer: Tandem Technology, Inc. Founder & CEO is Sahir Jaggi. Clinical Intelligence led by Adam Harris, MD and Kathleen Alvarez, NP.
availability: Available in the United States; availability abroad not clearly specified.
summary: Tandem is an AI-powered platform that automates end-to-end medication access workflows (prior authorization submission, appeals, pharmacy routing, affordability/patient assistance enrollment, and patient communication). Integrates with provider EHRs; offered free to providers and patients (per developer materials).
medicalPurpose: Automate steps of obtaining prior authorization for medications, including PA form generation/submission, appeals, pharmacy navigation, and patient communication.
acceptableInput: Electronic prescriptions (structured), clinical records/notes (unstructured), payer rules, insurance data, historical outcomes, and patient communications. Inputs include structured and unstructured clinical/admin data; outputs include structured forms, letters, routing instructions, portal updates, and SMS messages. Typical workflow includes e-prescribing to Tandem from the EHR, optional EHR integration for record retrieval, AI-generated PA form creation, provider review/approval, submission and follow-up, appeals generation with provider review, assistance program enrollment, pharmacy routing, and patient text updates.
output: Completed PA forms, payer follow-up coordination, appeal letters (clinician-approved), enrollment workflows, pharmacy routing, and real-time patient status communications via text; staff dashboards.
roleInDecisionMaking: Low-to-moderate; errors/delays could affect medication access; designed with human-in-the-loop provider review. Automate steps of obtaining prior authorization for medications, including PA form generation/submission, appeals, pharmacy navigation, and patient communication.
intendedUsers: Physicians, nurse practitioners, and practice staff at outpatient practices; also used in workflows involving patients waiting to receive medications. No specialized technical knowledge described; requires provider e-prescribing capability.
targetPatientPopulation: U.S. patients requiring medications with prior authorization.
knownFailureModes: Described limitations include scope focused on medication PAs (not all categories), variability in performance for complex cases or non-responsive patients, not a full replacement for PA specialists, and limited public disclosure of model error rates.
